Alex (CSE): quick heads-up — acme corp's hosted usage popped overnight. daily burn is ~112% of their committed daily target, flagged by billing bot :warning:
BillingBot: automated alert — account=acme, 24h_spend_pct_of_commit=112, embeddings_tokens=3.4M (+230% vs daily avg), generated_tokens=0.8M. see dashboard: https://console.redwood.ai/accounts/acme/usage
Jordan (CSE): thanks. looking at traces now. latency is fine overall but there was a 3min error-rate blip around 11:32 PST (5xxs from generator pool) — might be a batch job retry storm.
Alex (CSE): can you paste the query you ran? want to confirm embeddings source (ingestion vs embed-on-read).
Jordan (CSE): pulling raw usage: ```SELECT timestamp, route, tokens, model FROM usage_logs WHERE account_id='acme' AND timestamp >= now()-interval '1 day' ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 200;```
Jordan (CSE): early filter shows most extra tokens on /v1/embeddings with model=text-embed-ada-large and a handful of long vectors from ingestion pipeline.
Linda (Account Manager): reaching out to acme CS contact (cc @alex) to ask if they rolled a new batch or changed client config. I'll propose a quick opt-in throttle while we investigate.
Alex (CSE): action plan: 1) Linda to confirm whether batch was intentional. 2) Jordan to correlate error spike with autoscaling events and mark any generator fallbacks. 3) I’ll open a short-lived spend-override (cap) on hosted until we confirm.
InfraBot: note — autoscaler triggered 2 scale-ups between 11:29-11:35, no failed provision events.
BillingBot: created anomaly ticket #ANOM-2027-331 for acme; tentative severity: medium; recommended: contact + temporary cap.
Jordan (CSE): next step for eng if we see repeated 5xxs: `@eng-runtime` to check generator pool kernel OOMs / quantized model restarts. For now error rate has subsided to normal.
Linda (Account Manager): scheduled 15m sync with acme at 1400 PST. will report back here after call. :calendar:
Alex (CSE): thanks — marking this thread as monitoring. will update the account record with the cap and follow-up notes. :thumbsup:
